chunks: Abu Ja'far عليه السلام instructed that lamentation for him be held during the seasons for ten years.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja'far, a title of Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام
key_terms.الْمَوَاسِمِ: the seasons or recurring gathering times, especially pilgrimage seasons
key_terms.وَأَوْصَى: he instructed or made a will
key_terms.يُنْدَبَ: that lamentation or mourning be performed

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام instruct regarding mourning for him after his death?
ai.summary: This report states that Abu Ja'far عليه السلام gave instructions that mourning lamentation for him be conducted in the pilgrimage seasons for ten years. It reflects a historical and devotional practice connected to remembrance and public mourning for the Imam عليه السلام.
